Job description:
We are looking for an individual in the financial markets sector who is well-versed in Artificial Intelligence tools and engines, has the ability for professional prompt engineering, and can increase team efficiency through process automation (n8n) (and Python programming if needed), and is keen on growth in a dynamic team.

Responsibilities: Design and implement AI-based solutions for process automation, build Chatbots and smart assistants for customer responses, connect AI tools to CRM, email, and internal systems, design intelligent Agents to perform various tasks across departments, analyze data, and provide smart reports, and train and optimize the use of AI in various company units.

Skills and Minimum Requirements: Young, motivated, committed, goal-oriented, and creative. Practical experience in designing agents, chatbots, or automation. Familiarity with LLMs such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity or open-source models. Relative mastery of Prompt Engineering and Workflow design. Familiarity with concepts like RAG, Embedding, Vector Database, and Knowledge Base. Experience working with n8n or similar tools. Familiarity with API, Webhook, and service connections. Initial familiarity with JavaScript or Python is an advantage. Product sense, a learner, an executor, and a problem-solver. Ability to turn an organizational need into a usable MVP. Familiarity with Automation and Workflow. If the individual has experience in sales and marketing, it is considered a significant advantage.

Note: Individuals who only know how to use ChatGPT, N8N, CLOUD, etc., casually are not suitable for this position. We are looking for an individual or a team that can actually build systems and automate tasks.

Collaboration Type: On-site – Full-time. Location: Early Yousef Abad (near Fatemi), Tehran. Working Hours: Saturday to Wednesday, 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM. Salary and Benefits: Paid in USD based on experience and capabilities, regularly on the first day of every Persian month.

Company description:
✅ About us: We are a professional, young, and energetic team operating in the finance sector. The group includes: • VIP channel for crypto analysis and signaling • High-level training courses • Investment and fast-growth trading consulting. We are now looking for a fresh force who can help us further in our progress with new ideas, high energy, and an open mind.
